purpose: Publish a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy and a threat model whose prevention and detection entries cite controls that actually exist, stating residual risk plainly where they do not.
requiredInvariants: No exploitable detail, reproduction steps, secrets or CROWN_JEWEL source may be published.
No mitigation may be claimed that is not backed by an existing gate, migration or code path.
Absent controls must be stated as residual risk, never omitted to make the posture look better.
No personal contact data may be published; private reporting goes through GitHub's built-in channel.
The public status of the repository and the irreversibility of prior disclosure must be stated honestly.
Qwen remains THIRD_PARTY_INFRASTRUCTURE and must never be presented as the rights holder's own model.
No product code, dependency, workflow or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
acceptance: SECURITY.md gives a private reporting route that costs nothing and exposes no personal data.
The threat model covers the programme's required threat list including tenant breakout, settlement manipulation, supply chain, CI compromise, RAG poisoning, prompt injection and model extraction.
Every threat carries a residual risk and the open gaps are ranked rather than buried.
Claimed controls correspond to gates observable in CI or to code present in the tree.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the three authorized paths.
